verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a written API reference with static code snippets (for example, exec, writeFile and watch examples) and an OpenAPI JSON file. Nothing shows an interactive reference where users can run examples in the docs, such as a try-it console or playground. Static snippets and a machine-readable spec are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
